description: Overland Flood Alerts is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Manitoba | Gouvernement du Manitoba. Current weather induced overland flood alerts The Hydrologic Forecast Centre (HFC) issues several categories of flood alert throughout the year including riverine flooding due to snowmelt and rainfall, wind and wave induced shoreline flooding and ice pileup, and rainfall induced overland flooding. Coverage: Government of Manitoba. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Manitoba | Gouvernement du Manitoba. Its tags are Manitoba, Flood, Hydrologic Forecast Center, Alerts, Flood Watch. It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-06-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OpenMB Information and Data Use License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
